meta.name: verify
meta.description: Drive an engine app headlessly in a pty, record a video of the whole verification, and open a summary page (video + timeline + checks) with pixel open.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 驱动应用自动验证,录制全程视频并打开摘要页
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要自动驱动应用运行并留下验证记录视频。
copy.tagline_en: Drive an app headlessly, record its verification, and open a summary page
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate app verification and capture a video record

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会用 tools/verify-recorder 里的 Driver/Recorder，在 pty 里无头驱动你的引擎应用，把每一帧录成视频，记录检查项和命名截图，最后生成含视频、可点击时间线和检查表的 summary.html 页面。
howto.when: 当你要求验证某个通过 kitty graphics protocol 渲染的引擎应用时接管——它不需要真实终端，可指定窗口尺寸与像素坐标，并断言帧变化或解码后的像素颜色。

say.text: 验证这个引擎应用的点击命中，检查项要用真实断言
say.note: 检查结果显示为 pass/fail 表格

say.text: 跑一次验证，结束后打开 summary.html
say.note: 会打印 run 目录和 summary 路径

howto.what_en: Claude drives your engine app headlessly in a pty via tools/verify-recorder, records every frame to a video, logs checks and named stills, and produces a summary.html with video, clickable timeline, and checks table.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want to verify an engine app that renders via the kitty graphics protocol; it needs no real terminal and can assert on frame deltas or decoded pixel colors.

say_en.text: Write a verify script for wheel scrolling, then pixel open the summary
say_en.note: Records a video and a timeline summary page

say_en.text: Verify click hit-testing in this engine app with real assertions
say_en.note: Checks show up as a pass/fail table

say_en.text: Run the verification and open summary.html when it finishes
say_en.note: Prints the run dir and summary path
